purpose: A local channel is judged on whether it turned up for the things its town cares about. Missing Krishna Janmashtami in Udupi, or posting a Rajyotsava card on the 2nd, is the kind of miss a reader remembers longer than any good story. This file is what scripts/calendar.py reads to tell you what is coming.

how_dates_work.fixed: Solar or civil. The date is the date. Safe to schedule against.
how_dates_work.lunar: Moves every year with the panchanga. The MONTH here is reliable and the DAY is not recorded, because inventing one would be worse than leaving it blank — a greeting posted on the wrong day is more embarrassing than no greeting. Confirm each from a Udupi panchanga at the start of its month; scripts/calendar.py reminds you.
how_dates_work.season: Not a day at all — a window the desk should be reporting inside.

observances.note: The single biggest greeting of the year for a Kannada channel. Red and yellow are the flag's, not the brand's — the greeting theme handles it.
Solar, so it is 14 or 15 January. Confirm which for the year; most years it is the 14th in Karnataka. ಎಳ್ಳು ಬೆಲ್ಲ is the image.
Tulu new year, and coastal in a way a statewide channel will not cover. This is a differentiator, not a duty.
Coastal Karnataka has a large Christian community. Not optional here.
February or early March. Confirm from the panchanga.
Kannada new year. March or April. ಬೇವು ಬೆಲ್ಲ.
Coastal and Tulu-specific — ಹಾಲೆ ಮರದ ಕಷಾಯ. Almost nobody statewide covers it, which is exactly why this channel should.
Naga worship is strong in coastal Karnataka. Deity dignity rules apply hard — see D54 keep_clear.
Udupi's own. Krishna Mutt, Mosaru Kudike, the whole town. If this channel gets one greeting right in the year, it is this one — and it deserves footage, not a card.
Already has a footage playbook and a licensed bed. Plan the shoot, not just the card.
Nine days, so this is a series and not a post. Mysuru Dasara dominates statewide coverage; the coastal angle is the local temples.
Islamic lunar — moves ~11 days earlier each year, so the month here drifts. Bhatkal, Ullal and Mangaluru have large communities. Confirm locally.
A greeting is the wrong register for Good Friday. A respectful note, not ಶುಭಾಶಯ.

seasons.desk: The channel's busiest and most useful season. NH66 landslides, low-lying flooding, Souparnika and Swarna river levels, school holidays declared by the DC, power cuts. IMD and the Udupi DC are the sources that matter. Weather cards are the most-saved format there is — build the daily habit here.
Annual monsoon trawling ban. Directly affects Malpe, Gangolli and Byndoor harbours — thousands of households. Confirm the exact dates with the Fisheries department each year; they shift.

SSLC and PUC exams, then results. Timetables, centre changes, results and helplines are pure utility content — the kind that gets saved and forwarded rather than liked. Source: KSEAB, never a WhatsApp forward.
Pre-monsoon. Baje and Shiroor dam levels, tanker schedules, borewell notices.
Coastal Karnataka's own sport and a genuine footage opportunity — real crowds, real sound, and it performs on YouTube in a way a card never will. Animal-welfare framing needs care.
Mela season. Badagutittu is the local style — get it right, and get the artists' names right from the organiser rather than from the poster. Footage, not cards.
Retreating monsoon and Arabian Sea cyclone watch. INCOIS for sea state, IMD for the rest.

recurring_reviews.what: Indian media law moves. The BNS came in, the IT Rules were amended for synthetically generated information, and both will move again. Re-read docs/DECISIONS.md D29, D49 and D59 against what the law actually says now, and check whether the guilt-verb list and the POCSO location rules still match. Put a date in docs/DECISIONS.md whether or not anything changed — 'we looked and nothing moved' is a finding.

python3 scripts/metrics.py report. Every number in tokens.Limits is a hypothesis until this argues with it. If a slot or a reel length wins consistently, change the constant, write the decision, and let the test fail until everything agrees.

Walk assets/LICENCES.json against what is actually in assets/bgm_options/. A bed whose licence page has gone dead is a Content ID claim waiting to happen, and the time to find out is not after the strike.

A backup nobody has restored is a hope. Untar the newest archive from .backups into /tmp and confirm archive/ and assets/stock/ are actually in it and actually open. This is the single cheapest insurance in the whole system.
assets/stock/ is the cheapest picture desk there is. Prune frames that dated badly, and check CATALOG.md still describes what is there in words somebody would search for.
